```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(NHANES)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

data(NHANES)

# Adults 18 and older, with the variables used in the lab
nhanes_analysis <- NHANES |>
  filter(Age >= 18) |>
  select(ID, Gender, Age, Race1, Education, BMI, Pulse, BPSys1, BPDia1,
         PhysActive, Smoke100, SmokeNow, Diabetes, HealthGen) |>
  mutate(
    Hypertension = factor(ifelse(BPSys1 >= 140 | BPDia1 >= 90, "Yes", "No"))
  )
```
